long_run_goals.text: Open the tier-3 customs vault with an abyssal pearl and a restored boat; the seal unlocks a new core family, not just a bigger chest.
Dive the Great Cenote after combining thermal, filter and climb preparation; map the subsurface conduit to the Ashwater resurgence.
Restore the buried pump station to change safe fen channels, then run a purification/venom-core loop that revalues bog iron and peat.
Anneal storm glass and power the Glasswind light to reveal tide-gated wrecks and a coastal shortcut.
Solve the living-wood root lift to reach the canopy temple and a venom-core specimen without a boss-only gate.

regions.geology: Ancient caldera rim and funerary plateau; legacy Marches inset preserved.
regions.identity: Ten existing dungeon doors remain in the legacy inset. New buffer roads teach salvage, fording and outpost return without moving a single entrance.
regions.name: The Ashen Crown
regions.revisit_hook: Re-open the four legacy shortcuts; learn seal/power grammar at the buffer waystation before leaving the quarter.

regions.geology: Glacial cirques, arêtes and a hanging valley draining south-west.
regions.identity: Snowline is an equipment test, not a level wall. The pass is visible from the Crown but the exposed ridge punishes unprepared travellers.
regions.name: Frostcrown Reach
regions.revisit_hook: Thaw-season veins, ice-cave cores and a high observatory that only powers after a thermal ward.

regions.geology: Wave-cut terraces and silica cliffs; a short fast river falls to the east coast.
regions.identity: Lighthouses and wreck stairs reward coastal navigation. Storm glass forms where lightning meets silica sand.
regions.name: Glasswind Coast
regions.revisit_hook: Tide-gated wrecks and a storm-warded signal tower; revisit after cap_stormward.

regions.geology: Basalt flows, cinder cones and sulfur fumaroles east of the Crown escarpment.
regions.identity: Foundries and convict mines explain the industrial ruins. Heat and acid gas create preparation choices distinct from cold.
regions.name: Embersteppe
regions.revisit_hook: Fumarole cycles open obsidian seams; restore the old forge to refine higher cores.

regions.geology: Raised coral benches, a terminal salt pan and a wadi joining the Glasswind river.
regions.identity: Caravanserais and a tidal harbor make this the trade hinge. Water, not monsters, is the first logistics tax.
regions.name: Saffron Coast
regions.revisit_hook: Caravan contracts, salt-pan harvesting after dry wind, and a harbor drydock for boats.

regions.geology: Folded limestone ridges and steep rainforest valleys; orographic rain feeds the south river.
regions.identity: Dense canopy hides terraced ruins. Poison and verticality reward filter gear and climbing, not raw damage.
regions.name: The Verdant Fold
regions.revisit_hook: Canopy temples, venom-core specimens and a root elevator opened by a living-wood puzzle.
regions.soils: deep ferralitic clay and leaf litter

regions.geology: Distributary channels, tidal flats and mangrove peat at the Glasswind mouth.
regions.identity: Stilt villages and drowned customs houses form a boat-dependent maze. Tide changes which channels are safe.
regions.name: Pearl Mangroves
regions.revisit_hook: Abyssal pearls in tide-locked grottoes; a floating outpost earns its keep by shortening the return leg.

regions.geology: Old moraine hills south of the caldera; a gentle stream reaches the south coast.
regions.identity: The first genuinely new farming and timber belt. Abandoned orchards and a watermill give non-dungeon progression.
regions.name: Amberwood March
regions.revisit_hook: Mill repair unlocks a plank route; old stored fruit becomes valuable after a fermentation recipe.
regions.soils: brown forest earth and orchard terraces

regions.geology: A fault-dammed lake receives the Crown river and the Frostcrown tributary.
regions.identity: Fishers' piles, a drowned causeway and a lake observatory. The lake is a transport hub once a hull is built.
regions.name: Mirrormere Basin
regions.revisit_hook: Drowned vault revealed by lowering a sluice; freshwater pearls and a ferry shortcut.

regions.geology: Tower karst, sinkholes and a submarine spring; surface water disappears underground.
regions.identity: Ruined orchard terraces collapse into cenotes. A visible sinkhole hints at the Ashwater resurgence long before it is usable.
regions.name: Sunken Orchard
regions.revisit_hook: Cenote diving after cap_deepward; a grafting puzzle revalues Amberwood cuttings.

regions.geology: Peat basin fed by the Mirrormere outlet and a karst resurgence; slow drainage to the south coast.
regions.identity: A poisoned wetland with stilt shrines and a buried pump station. Filter gear and boardwalks matter more than armour.
regions.name: Ashwater Fen
regions.revisit_hook: Pump restoration changes safe channels; a bog-core specimen and a late-game purification loop.
regions.soils: acid peat and toxic ash lenses
